prompt: Load the daily CRM customer files into the warehouse as a customer dimension: one row per customer. If the same customer appears in more than one daily file, keep the most recent version of that customer. Keep all source columns with sensible types and record which file each row came from. Name the table dim_customers.

Load the weekly vendor price sheets into the warehouse, keeping every week so the price history is preserved: one row per price line per weekly sheet. Keep all source columns with sensible types and record which file and which week each row came from. Add a loaded_at column holding the UTC timestamp of the load. Name the table vendor_prices.

Combine the ERP purchase orders with their purchase order lines into one warehouse table with one row per purchase order line, carrying the order-level fields (supplier, dates, status and similar) onto each line. Every line must match exactly one purchase order. Keep all source columns with sensible types. Add a loaded_at column holding the UTC timestamp of the load. Name the table purchase_order_lines.

Load the ERP inventory movements into the warehouse as a fact table with one row per movement. Keep all source columns with sensible types, and make sure each movement appears exactly once. Add a loaded_at column holding the UTC timestamp of the load. Name the table inventory_movements.
